title: Mabunyi Cowpea (UPL Cp 5): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Mabunyi Cowpea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Mabunyi cowpea is a cowpea variety. About 49 days to harvest. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others. Free guide.
excerpt: Mabunyi is a registered cowpea variety, also sold or known as UPL Cp 5. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1985. It takes about 49 days from sowing to the first harvest.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for UPL Cp 5, this is the same cowpea. items: **Days to harvest:** about 49 days from sowing to the first harvest.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Mabunyi cowpea takes about 49 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is 4.3 days faster than the average of the 13 cowpea varieties with a day count, 53.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit cowpea fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 17 cm long. The seed coat is pigmented brown and white.
Where and when to plant Mabunyi cowpea

Cowpea fits the dry season after rice, on the moisture the paddy keeps. Pick by use: green pods for vegetables, or dry seed. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is UPL Cp 5 the same as Mabunyi?
items.a: Yes. UPL Cp 5 is another name for Mabunyi. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 49 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Mabunyi?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
